# Echoes

**Explore history in depth through authentic stereoscopic photography.**

Echoes brings history to life through stereoscopic photographs captured from the mid-1800s and beyond. Stand before real moments from the past and experience them in natural depth, witnessing both major historical events and the everyday lives of the people who lived them.
